# What api-diff's focus job (and api-probe with [api-focus]) prints straight into its log; the workflows list the kinds
# of line. "datadiff <path>" lines are printed by api-diff's overrides job, OLD's file against NEW's.
# New-moon darkness: the 26.4 lightmap
sig net.minecraft.client.renderer.LightmapRenderStateExtractor
findsig LightmapRenderState
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.LightmapRenderStateExtractor .
member net.minecraft.client.multiplayer.ClientLevel SkyDarken|skyDarken|getSkyFlash|environmentAttributes
member net.minecraft.world.level.dimension.DimensionType hasSkyLight|skylight
calls net.minecraft.world.attribute.EnvironmentAttributes <clinit>
datadir timeline
data timeline/day.json
data timeline/moon.json
data dimension_type/overworld.json
assets shaders/core
asset shaders/core/lightmap.fsh
# The watchling's model and animation
calls net.minecraft.client.model.monster.enderman.EndermanModel .
sig net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel
calls net.minecraft.client.model.HumanoidModel setupAnim|setupAttackAnimation|createMesh|poseRightArm|poseLeftArm|getArm|<init>
calls net.minecraft.client.model.geom.builders.PartDefinition addOrReplaceChild
sig net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.state.HumanoidRenderState
sig net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.state.EndermanRenderState
sig net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EndermanRenderer
calls net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.EndermanRenderer extractRenderState
member net.minecraft.client.renderer.entity.HumanoidMobRenderer extractHumanoidRenderState
member net.minecraft.client.model.geom.ModelPart resetPose|getInitialPose|PartPose
member net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob setTarget|getTarget
calls net.minecraft.world.entity.Mob setTarget
